claims.evidence: All 19 PBS_* raw files in the PRIDE file list; the same 19 runs are the only raw files in the PBS MaxQuant summary.txt (experiments P1-P6 x 0x/1x/2xPBS and QC1-3)
Run names PBS_P<n>_<k>xPBS; Table S1 lists patients P1-P6; paper 4.1 'Six patient samples'

claims.value: no PBS wash / 1 PBS wash / 2 PBS washes
claims.evidence: Run-name tokens 0xPBS / 1xPBS / 2xPBS; paper 4.1 'unwashed or subjected to one or two PBS washes'; Table S1 shows no 2nd wash for P1 and P4, matching the absent PBS_P1_2xPBS / PBS_P4_2xPBS files. No NCIT/EFO term exists for a PBS wash count (OLS searched), so the values are free text
The QC pool mixes aliquots of all three wash levels, so no single treatment applies
Each wash group holds independent patient samples; numbering by patient keeps the pairing across washes
Paper 4.1 / PRIDE protocol: patient cells were stored in liquid nitrogen in 10% DMSO / 20% FBS before thawing and the wash experiment; constant across rows, so not encoded as a column

claims.value: pooled; individual pooled; biological replicate pooled; technical replicate 1-3
claims.evidence: PRIDE: 'A pool containing equal amounts of all the samples was used as QC and analyzed three times'; Figure S1 caption: 'QC1-3 are pools of P1-P6 samples'
Paper 4.1: AML patient samples from the AML biobank; MONDO:0018874. PRIDE dropdown says 'acute leukemia' (DOID:12603), the paper is more specific. No healthy-control arm exists
Paper 4.1: patients with high peripheral blood blast counts; density-gradient (Lymphoprep) separated circulating mononuclear cells, >=95% leukemic blasts; UBERON:0000178, CL:2000001
PRIDE organisms NEWT:9606; AML patients; human Swiss-Prot FASTA in parameters.txt
Neither the paper nor Table S1 gives per-patient age or sex
Raw header 'Method of Q Exactive HF', 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS', folder '2017-04-30_QExactiveHF_3h_PBS-wash-test'; paper 4.4. PRIDE dropdown says 'Q Exactive' (less specific)

claims.location: comment[dissociation method], [collision energy], [ms2 mass analyzer], [ms1 scan range]
claims.evidence: Method 'Sensitive_TOP12HCD_120K-30K...'; 'NCE / stepped NCE 28'; full MS scan range 375 to 1500 m/z at 120,000, dd-MS2 at 30,000 (Orbitrap)
parameters.txt 'MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm'; MS2 was acquired in the Orbitrap
summary.txt Enzyme=Trypsin, mode Specific for every raw file; PRIDE data processing protocol 'Trypsin was set as protease'; paper 4.4 'Trypsin was used as digestion protease'

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl (UNIMOD:4, C, Fixed); Oxidation (UNIMOD:35, M, Variable); Acetyl (UNIMOD:1, Protein N-term, Variable)
claims.evidence: parameters.txt 'Fixed modifications: Carbamidomethyl (C)'; summary.txt 'Variable modifications: Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term)' for every raw file; matches paper section 4.4

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method] all rows
claims.evidence: Raw-file method names TOP12CID / TOP12HCD (top-12 data-dependent MS/MS); PRIDE experiment type Shotgun proteomics
PRIDE quantification 'MS1 intensity based label-free quantification'; paper 4.4 LFQ mode; summary.txt multiplicity 1, no labels

limitations: Age, sex and ancestry of the six patients are not reported (age/sex = not available; ancestry omitted).
Cell type 'peripheral blood mononuclear cell' describes the density-gradient fraction (>=95% leukemic blasts); no CL term for leukemic blast was used.
QC pool encoded as one pooled source with technical replicates 1-3.
Instrument/acquisition settings read from 2 of 19 raw headers; the rest assumed identical (same folder and search).
Precursor mass tolerance omitted: MaxQuant 1.5 parameters.txt does not report it and no mqpar.xml was deposited.
characteristics[treatment] values are free text (no NCIT/EFO term for a PBS wash count); the validator reports 3 ontology warnings.
QC age/sex stay not available: the installed validator rejects pooled for age and sex (tested).
QC pooled sample stays pooled: an SN= list of the 16 source names raised a values warning (tested); the pool composition is documented here instead.
